notes.content: An unsigned visible page of a typed English letter dated at Voorschoten, with a French quotation and handwritten mathematical/punctuation additions. Paragraph 1 asks whether describing a covering by its behaviour over special covers gives the intended intuition. Paragraph 2 asks about the definition of Galois coverings, commuting actions and full faithfulness of geometric realization. Paragraph 3 asks whether example 3a consists of pairs M=(a,n), and suggests replacing the displayed inequality by a componentwise-multiple condition. These are the letter writer’s questions and claims, not mathematical conclusions verified in this run.

The group-letter alphabet and the case of the primed Hom subscript are not established by the ink and remain marked; no reading is selected from the expected theory.
